summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title(title) classmethod; rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title (gated only on is_terminal, returns True when written, False otherwise) beside show_cursor/set_alt_screen; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title) once per title control; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased (above Fixed) linking PR 2200. Tests appended: test_control.py (title segment), test_console.py (forced terminal, empty environment, assertion skipped on legacy Windows), test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only set_title mock assertion). Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests and mypy are unverified. Nothing committed.
